==English==
{{wp|<dab!>}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*kʷ-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|qualite}}, from {{der|en|fro|qualité}}, from {{der|en|la|quālitās|quālitās, quālitātem}}, from {{m|la|quālis||of what kind}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*kʷo-||who, how}}. Cicero coined {{m|la|qualitas}} as a calque to translate the {{cog|grc|-}} word {{m|grc|ποιότης||quality}}, coined by Plato from {{m|grc|ποῖος||of what nature, of what kind}}.

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|countable}} The [[kind]], [[condition]], and/or the set of [[characteristic]]s of something, as opposed to the quantity of something.
#: {{antonym|en|quantity}}
#: {{ux|en|The lattice structure of a steel profoundly changes its '''qualities'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Jonson Poetaster|act=III|scene=iv|url=https://archive.org/stream/poetasterorarrai00jons_0#page/n62/mode/1up|passage=''Tuc''[''ca'']. {{...}} Can thy Author doe it impudently enough? / ''Hiſt''[''rio'']. O, I warrant you, Captaine: and ſpitefully inough too; he ha's one of the moſt ouerflowing villanous wits, in ''Rome''. He will ſlander any man that breathes; If he diſguſt him. / ''Tucca''. I'le know the poor, egregious, nitty Raſcall; and he haue ſuch commendable '''Qualities''', I'le cheriſh him: {{...}}}}
#* {{RQ:Wodehouse Jeeves in the Offing|chapter=XX|passage=“That's life,” she said, and buzzed off to keep her vigil, leaving me kicking myself because I'd forgotten to say anything about the '''quality''' of mercy not being strained. It isn't, as I dare say you know, and a mention of this might just have done the trick.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|title=A Bad Man| url=https://books.google.com/books?isbn=1453204067| author=w:Stanley Elkin| year=2010| passage=Something about his bearing was uncommitted, as though he were checking not for some bad '''quality''' he knew Feldman had, but for some good '''quality''' he was afraid he might have.}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} A single [[trait]].
#: {{ux|en|While being impulsive can be great for artists, it is not a desirable '''quality''' for engineers.}}
#: {{ux|en|Security, stability, and efficiency are good '''qualities''' of an operating system.}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} Good characteristics in particular; level of [[excellence]]; freedom of faults and flaws.
#: {{syn|en|duty|q1=usually used in combination}}
#: {{ux|en|This school is well-known for having teachers of high '''quality'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Quality''' of life is usually determined by health, education, and income.}}
#* {{RQ:Wodehouse Jeeves in the Offing|chapter=I|passage=“I'll tell you what you're going to do. Have you a clean shirt?” “Several.” “And a toothbrush?” “Two, both of the finest '''quality'''.” “Then pack them. You're coming to Brinkley tomorrow.”}}
# {{lb|en|attributive|occasionally|proscribed}} [[good|Good]] [[worth]], good [[make]].
#: {{ux|en|For this building project we need to use '''quality''' materials that will last for many decades.}}
#: {{ux|en|That was a '''quality''' game by Jim Smith.}}
#: {{ux|en|We had some [[quality time|'''quality''' time]] yesterday!}}
#: {{ux|en|A '''quality''' system ensures products meet customer requirements.}}
# {{lb|en|archaic}} [[position|Position]]; [[status]]; [[rank]].
#* {{quote-book|en|title=A Full and True Relation of the Great and Wonderful Revolution That Hapned Lately in the Kingdom of Siam in the East-Indies|chapter=[[s:A Full and True Relation of the Great and Wonderful Revolution That Hapned Lately in the Kingdom of Siam in the East-Indies/Preface|The Preface to the Reader]]|year=1690|location=London|page=i|publisher=Randal Taylor|text=The firſt Solemn Embaſſy that the French King ſent to the late King of SIAM, was in the Year 1685, by Monſieur de Chaumont, who went in '''Quality''' of Ambaſſador Extraordinary {{...}}}}
# {{lb|en|archaic}} [[high|High]] [[social]] [[position]]. (See also {{m|en|the quality}}.)
#: {{ux|en|A peasant is not allowed to fall in love with a lady of '''quality'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|Membership of this golf club is limited to those of '''quality''' and wealth.}}
# {{lb|en|thermodynamics}} In a two-[[phase]] [[liquid]]–[[vapor]] mixture, the [[ratio]] of the [[mass]] of vapor present to the total mass of the mixture.
# {{lb|en|emergency medicine|countable}} The third step in [[OPQRST]] where the responder investigates what the [[NOI]]/[[MOI]] feels like.
#: {{ux|en|To identify '''quality''' try asking, "what does it feel like?".}}
# {{lb|en|countable|UK|journalism}} A [[newspaper]] with relatively [[serious]], high-quality [[content]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1998|author=Bill Coxall; Lynton Robins; Robert Leach|title=Contemporary British Politics|page=164
|passage=It is argued that in the last ten years or so, quality broadsheet newspapers have become more like the tabloids. Anthony Sampson has argued that 'the frontier between the '''qualities''' and popular papers has virtually disappeared'.}}
